summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The 21Shares Canton Network ETF (TCAN) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long cc, short usd currency. The fund provides exposure to the price performance of Canton Coin (CC). The fund holds assets designed to track the spot value of CC, offering a way to gain price exposure without directly holding the cryptocurrency TCAN was launched on May 7, 2026 and is issued by 21Shares.
